page: Microsoft Azure M416s_8_v3 is an ultra-high-memory server instance within the MSHighMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system delivers 416 dedicated Intel x86_64 virtual cores backed by non-shared CPU allocation. System memory capacity totals 7,600 GB, resulting in an extensive resource density of 18.27 GB of system RAM per virtual CPU. The instance does not feature hardware acceleration, providing zero GPUs.

The server provides no integrated local disk storage, requiring persistent storage and temporary scratch space to operate entirely over network-attached volumes via Azure Premium Storage capabilities. This architecture decouples data persistence from host lifecycle events but shifts storage performance to remote throughput limits rather than low-latency onboard NVMe media. Deployments require dedicated storage planning to ensure external I/O can support system checkpointing and memory-reloading phases.

Consolidating 416 vCPUs and 7.6 TB of RAM into a single node provides architectural efficiency for large monolithic software that suffers from distributed coordination overhead across multiple nodes. Cost efficiency depends directly on continuous, high-density memory utilization to prevent carrying underutilized hardware allocations. Microsoft Azure M416s_8_v3 is designed specifically for extreme memory-resident workloads, including mission-critical SAP HANA deployments, massive transactional relational databases, large-scale in-memory key-value caching, and real-time enterprise analytics.
description: Microsoft Azure M416s_8_v3 is a memory-optimized cloud server from the MSHighMemoryv3 family designed for extreme in-memory computing workloads. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance features 416 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel processors alongside 7,600 GB of total system memory, translating to approximately 18.27 GB of RAM per virtual core. The server includes no integrated local storage and contains no discrete GPU accelerators, operating entirely with remote Premium Storage volumes for persistent disk input and output. With dedicated CPU allocation and an expansive memory footprint, the instance eliminates virtualization contention for massive monolithic workloads. The absence of onboard NVMe disks necessitates careful consideration of remote storage throughput and network configurations. M416s_8_v3 is engineered specifically for massive in-memory database environments, such as large-scale SAP HANA deployments, massive in-memory caching tiers, high-scale transactional databases, and memory-bound enterprise resource planning platforms.
